summary: Jackson County, IN lookout planned on Houston hill after 1935 federal land purchase; listed as not standing and gone; a communications tower stands at the site now.

facts.status_note: Indiana Fire Towers: not standing, communications tower on site now; FFLA list: gone; removal date not found
facts.agency: Pleasant Run Ranger District, Hoosier National Forest

events.note: First federal land bought in Jackson County for the Pleasant Run unit: forty acres near the top of Houston hill; the Banner reported it was said the Forest Service would erect a fire tower there (hearsay)
Caption of the 1986 Bloomington quadrangle on Indiana Fire Towers shows the lookout to the east of a radio tower

evidence.supports: site is Hoosier National Forest property in the old Pleasant Run Purchase Unit

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches on name, county, coordinates, agency and status (gone). No construction date found: the only 1935 source says the Forest Service would erect a tower, so no built event is recorded. Indiana Fire Towers says the site is a turnoff with a communications tower now; access to the turnoff is not described in any source read. Houston does not appear in the Forest Service list of DNR towers (only Skyline is named for Jackson County). Staffing and fires not found. The record's access stays unknown.
